messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: auth-failure rate x500 from ap-southeast-1 edge cluster. Spike of 401/429 on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Paging oncall. thread_ts=1725553333

julia: seeing repeated failed token refreshes + high request fanout. IPs concentrated but UA strings rotate. looks like credential stuffing + scraper fanout.

omar: dumping sample logs:
```
2026-02-18T03:12:01Z edge-ap-southeast-1 GET /v1/embeddings 401 token=*** 1200r/s src=103.45.12.8 UA="curl/7.79.1"
2026-02-18T03:12:01Z edge-ap-southeast-1 POST /v1/chat 429 token=*** 900r/s src=103.45.12.9 UA="python-requests/2.31.0"
```

eng-security: agree tilt towards credential stuffing. propose: enable WAF rule WAF-892 (credential-stuffing signature), enable tarpit for suspicious signatures (5s response), and flip geo quota for APAC down to 60% of baseline.

sre_oncall: immediate mitigations we can do now:
- geo quota cut APAC -> 60%
- per-IP strict rate limit (burst 50 -> 10r/s)
- disable embeddings bulk endpoint for ap-southeast-1 (temporarily)
- enable WAF-892 in blocking mode
Please exec and report back.

platform-prod: applying geo quota cut for region ap-southeast-1 now. curl command: `POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/quotas?action=update & region=ap-southeast-1&scale=0.6`

deploy-bot: action=quota_update region=ap-southeast-1 status=IN_PROGRESS user=platform-prod

platform-prod: quota update completed (job id qc-20260218-01).

deploy-bot: action=quota_update region=ap-southeast-1 status=SUCCESS job=qc-20260218-01

platform-prod: disabling embeddings-bulk endpoint for ap-southeast-1: `PATCH /config/routes embeddings_bulk enabled=false region=ap-southeast-1`

julia: after WAF block + quota cut latency looks better and 5xx/429s trending down for control group. caveat: some enterprise connectors hit new 429s. we should allowlist enterprise SSO/resellers.

eng-security: adding temporary allowlist: tokens with metadata tag `enterprise=true` and ip range x.x.x.x/12 get bypass of geo quota and stricter rate rules. will push policy in 5m.

support-lead: creating outbound notices for affected customers in APAC. draft: "We observed elevated failed auth attempts and aggressive automated requests affecting service. We've applied temporary regional protections to preserve availability; you may see reduced throughput. We're prioritizing enterprise connectors for allowlist. Contact support if you see customer impact." Approving copy with product? @product-manager

product-manager: approved. please include ETA for rollback in comms: we expect reassess in 2 hours.

sre_oncall: monitoring: suspect IPs request rate down ~80% after WAF/tarpit. Legit customer 429s concentrated to 5 tokens — support to escalate and provide client token list for whitelisting.

support-lead: making tickets for top 5 impacted customers, reaching out with the approved note now.

eng-security: policy pushed: WAF-892 BLOCK, tarpit enabled for signature group alpha, enterprise allowlist added (policy id pol-792).

julia: handoff note -> keeping quota cut + embeddings-bulk disabled for at least 2 hours. If suspect traffic remains >10% baseline after 2h, escalate to region-wide hard block.

sre_oncall: handing to @natalie for night watch in 30 minutes. full action log + checklist in incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/1725553333

natalie: taking over. will monitor first 2h, coordinate with support for any critical customer issues, and loop back if we need escalation. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: severity updated -> SEV2. paging cleared for original oncall.

sre_oncall: closing active mitigation thread, leaving monitoring and follow-ups to @natalie. final note: keep WAF-892 and quota cut until traffic normalizes or product approves rollback.

natalie: acknowledged. I'll post updates every 30m or on notable changes.
